subject: ribbon-tailed pocket manta
pose: 正面悬浮，尾巴绕到胸前
art_direction: 一只扁平鳐形小生物把长尾折成领结，珊瑚色腹面与深蓝宽翼形成张力。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a pocket-sized manta creature with a broad diamond body and two short folded fins. Its long ribbon tail loops forward into an oversized bow beneath a tiny serious face. Show it hovering frontally, with one fin lifted as if correcting its balance. Build the entire design from deep navy, coral, and cream paper-cut shapes, without gradients or cast shadows. Give the outer contour a few unexpected rounded notches. Use a cream field and let the coral underside remain a bold central shape rather than decorative trim. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
